admission.justification: The launch-record source was weighed against the plugin hierarchy snapshot and against a new backend host-list route, with the attribution and readiness costs named.

alternatives.option: Read canonical launch records and verify each recorded agent's host state.
alternatives.reason: It needs no plugin readiness, carries the document labels directly and excludes native agents this product never started.

alternatives.option: Use the plugin's hierarchy snapshot, as the dashboard did before L75.
alternatives.reason: It makes URL navigation depend on plugin readiness and shows actors this product did not start as if the document owned them.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The product requires native actors it never started to appear in a task's chat panel.

alternatives.option: Read the host's whole list through a new backend route.
alternatives.reason: It rebuilds the plugin's catalog authority in the backend and keeps the same attribution problem.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The host exposes an authoritative per-document actor query the product must use.

consequences: role_document_chats becomes the panel's single discovery source, bounded at three host reads per page and paged for old Projects actors; the plugin snapshot stays unused by the dashboard.
context: The panel must learn which agents a selected task has. The plugin already posts the host's whole hierarchy snapshot, while the launch records know exactly which agents this product started.
decider: packet MIK-R95@v1 rule 2 and its open truth gap (the source for a task's agents)
